explication: AccessibilitySnapshot is an iOS accessibility-regression snapshot framework: tests capture a view, its accessibility hierarchy is parsed into a model, and snapshot renderers produce images with markers and legends for comparison. README documents two snapshot engines and support for keyboard and hit-target snapshots; source excerpts and index confirm the main parser/rendering calls. Some feature-specific implementation links are not shown, so those connections are omitted rather than inferred.
